remarks: Conveniently Located and Comfortable In-Town Living -- Welcome to 294 South Avenue. This home is ideal for a family desiring quick access to the Village of New Canaan, and walking distances to schools and parks. Meticulously maintained, and just updated (each room on the main level freshly painted, with new light fixtures, and completely refinished hardwood floors), this spacious Ranch/Cape Cod has 3 Bedrooms and 3 Baths. The Lower Level is completely finished and offers plenty of room for an Office, Recreation/Game Area or Play Area. Enjoy the convenience of a private deck, perfect for relaxing or hosting gatherings. Warm up during colder evenings by the fireplace in the spacious living room, or entertain guests in the bright and airy sunroom with brand new ceiling fan. The location is a dream come true -It is just moments away from schools, the library, town center, restaurants, the YMCA, and the New Canaan Train Station. It has City Water, City Sewer and Central Air Conditioning. And the Washer, Dryer, Air Fryer, and Microwave are brand new. The walk-up attic space and rooms in the finished basement offer ample storage space. South Elementary School, Saxe Middle School, New Canaan High School, and all of the activities and amenities of Waveny Park and Mead Park are within walking distance. The Village of New Canaan and Train Station are a short walk away. Access to the Merritt Parkway is 1.5 miles. This updated and meticulously kept home is move-in ready!
